🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives. Wildest Festival Yet 🤯🐮 Only in Nepal will you find a festival to do with people passing away, cows, dancing, cross dressing and loads more.  Welcome to Gai Jatra - which literally translates to cow festival.  There’s a huge historical story behind it which is too long to explain here but essentially people originally took cows through the street as a way of saying  final goodbye to their loved ones but now for practicality they use these giant effigies call Tahamacha.  Hospitality of Nepal is off to a fantastic start absolutely loving it here but it feels like there is a festival everyday in Nepal - full video on this will be out on the Youchooobz at some point.  #nepaltiktok #nepal #kathmandu #gaijatra

November 14, 2026 Gorkha District, Nepal A large dry landslide occurred in Gorkha District. A mass of earth and rock collapsed from the Gundrung Pakha slope into the Thado Bharyang forest area near Yarubagar. Rocks began falling as early as Friday night, and the main landslide took place around 8:30 a.m., kicking up a massive cloud of dust. Debris reached the Budhi Gandaki River. The landslide blocked both a motorable road and a foot trail. According to the district police, there were no casualties or material damage.
